description: Claude Code plugins by Bryan Frias.

plugins.name: issue-runner
plugins.description: Self-sufficient agentic GitHub issue pipeline: /issue-plan turns an idea into ready-to-run vertical-slice issues; /issue-runner builds a dependency DAG and dispatches each issue to an autonomous worktree-isolated implementer subagent that explores, implements, reviews (fresh-eyes subagents + Codex gate), and merges.
